# Generating function of the 4 X n counts a(n) for n >= 6.
# Sum_{n>=6} a(n)*x^n = P(x)/Q(x), with P of degree 444 and Q of degree 420, Q(0) = 1.
# The terms a(1)..a(5) = 1, 32, 224, 316, 1810 are not part of P/Q.
# So the full g.f. is x + 32*x^2 + 224*x^3 + 316*x^4 + 1810*x^5 + P(x)/Q(x).
# Q factors over the integers as follows (each factor written with constant term 1):
#   (1 - x)^2
#   (1 + x)^2
#   (1 + 3*x^2 - 2*x^3 + 2*x^4 - x^5)^3
#   (1 + x^2 - x^5)^3
#   (1 - x^2 - x^5 - 2*x^6)^3
#   (1 - 2*x - 2*x^2 - 2*x^3 - x^4 + 7*x^5 + 6*x^6 - 5*x^7 + 4*x^8 + 8*x^9 - 8*x^10 - 4*x^11)^5
#   (1 - x - x^2 - 4*x^3 + x^4 + 2*x^5 + x^6 + 4*x^7 - 3*x^8 + 5*x^9 - x^10 - 2*x^11 + 2*x^13 - 6*x^14 - 7*x^15 - 5*x^16 - 2*x^17)^3
#   (1 + x^2 - 4*x^3 - 4*x^4 + 2*x^5 + 3*x^6 - 2*x^7 + x^8 - 4*x^9 - 3*x^10 - 6*x^11 - 17*x^12 - 4*x^13 + 6*x^14 - 7*x^15 - 16*x^16 - 14*x^17 - 8*x^18 - 2*x^19)^3
#   (1 - 4*x + 2*x^2 + x^3 - 3*x^4 + 5*x^5 + x^6 - 3*x^7 + 7*x^8 + 2*x^9 + 30*x^10 - 7*x^11 + 10*x^12 + 12*x^13 + 2*x^14 + 17*x^15 + 26*x^16 + 19*x^17 - 26*x^18 - 4*x^19 + 8*x^20)^5
#   (1 - 2*x - x^2 - 2*x^3 - 8*x^4 - 4*x^5 + 3*x^6 - 2*x^7 + x^8 + 12*x^9 - 9*x^10 + 10*x^11 + 15*x^12 + 14*x^13 + 2*x^14 + 17*x^15 + 8*x^16 + 14*x^17 + 4*x^18 - 14*x^19 + 8*x^20 + 8*x^21)^5
# Lines "P k c" give the coefficient c of x^k in P, and lines "Q k c" the coefficient of x^k in Q.
